Buying a home is often considered one of the biggest financial milestones in India. But what if, instead of paying a home loan EMI, you rented a flat and invested the difference in mutual funds?
In this video, we compare two people: one who buys a flat and another who rents and invests in SIPs. We break down their expenses, investment returns, property appreciation, and net wealth over 5, 10, and 20 years to understand which option comes out ahead.
We've also created a calculator so you can enter your own numbers and compare both options before making a decision.
